title: An NPV and risk frontier endpoint
heading: The Frontier Endpoint Returns Only Non-Dominated Plans
cases: POST /frontier returns Pareto-optimal points sorted by risk removed, from the most-NPV end to the most-risk end, and refuses 1 or 12 points with 422
asked for two points, the frontier is exactly its two ends
when plans tie on the first objective, the end takes the one that is best on the second
two floors that lead to the same plan give one point, not two
when the best risk removed is not a whole number, the end keeps that optimum and takes the best NPV among the plans that reach it
